svg.title: HARTH temporal architecture engineering and participant-grouped benchmark
svg.desc: Consolidated Notebook 10 scientific workflow using the same HARTH v2.0 29-participant Development cohort. Six acceleration signals are windowed into 14,201 label-pure, time-continuous 500-cap windows, and a small participant-disjoint engineering subset is derived without rereading source data. Four advanced temporal architectures undergo input-shape, gradient and single-update checks. Seven classifiers then share three participant-grouped Development folds with Train-only preprocessing and matched source-row evaluation. Figures and source-window traces are schematic. No qualified held-out Test participants are loaded; the diagram shows methods rather than newly reproduced outcome scores.

g.text: HARTH TEMPORAL ARCHITECTURES AND MATCHED BENCHMARK
Official HARTH v2.0 · 29 Development participants · Seven models · Three paired folds
One bounded Development cohort · Train-only preprocessing · Participant-held-out evaluation
